title.original: DataParasite Enables Scalable and Repurposable Online Data Curation
title.zh: DataParasite支持可扩展和可重新利用的在线数据管理
title.en: DataParasite Enables Scalable and Repurposable Online Data Curation

inclusion_reason.zh: DataParasite 以通用脚本和轻量配置复用实体搜索与结构化抽取，提供透明、可扩展的在线数据组装基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: DataParasite reuses entity search and structured extraction through one generic runner and lightweight configuration, providing transparent, scalable online data-assembly infrastructure.

abstract.zh: DataParasite 是面向在线表格数据收集的开源模块化流水线，把任务拆成独立实体搜索，并用轻量配置和通用脚本复用于不同社会科学数据集。
abstract.en: DataParasite is an open-source modular pipeline for online tabular collection that decomposes work into entity-level searches and reuses a lightweight configuration plus task-agnostic script across datasets.

problem.zh: 从异构网站组装研究数据通常依赖大量人工劳动，现有智能体搜索系统又常因不透明、难配置而不利于科学复现。
problem.en: Assembling research data from heterogeneous sites is labor intensive, while existing agentic search systems are often opaque and hard to configure for reproducible science.

approach.zh: 用户以配置文件或自然语言描述表结构和搜索目标，框架并行执行实体级检索与结构化抽取，再将结果汇入统一表格。
approach.en: Users describe table structure and search goals through configuration or natural language; the framework runs independent entity searches and structured extraction before consolidating a common table.

system_design.zh: 共享 Python 执行器读取任务配置，将实体分发到可复用搜索单元，记录抽取结果并输出结构化数据；无预设实体列表的任务也可由指令生成搜索范围。
system_design.en: A shared Python runner reads the task configuration, dispatches entities to reusable search units, records extracted results, and emits structured data; instructions can also establish scope when no entity list exists.

key_results.zh: 在多项计算社会科学任务上，流水线保持较高准确性，并相对人工整理显著降低数据收集成本。
key_results.en: Across several computational-social-science tasks, the pipeline maintains high accuracy while materially reducing collection cost relative to manual curation.

limitations.zh: 网页变化、访问限制和模型抽取错误会影响复现；实体独立假设不适合强关联任务，当前评测领域也不足以代表所有在线数据场景。
limitations.en: Web drift, access restrictions, and model extraction errors affect reproducibility; entity independence does not fit strongly coupled tasks, and the evaluated domains do not represent all online-data settings.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
